visual.general_description: Two-panel H&E skin biopsy figure (A low power with two black arrows, B higher power) showing a dense cellular infiltrate with many clear vacuolated spaces.
visual.detailed_description: Panel A: Low-magnification pink and purple stained tissue filled with a dense, diffuse population of small cells with dark nuclei, scattered pink eosinophilic material and many pale, clear or vacuolated spaces. Two small black arrows point into the infiltrate, one left of center and one right of center. Round vessel-like profiles with surrounding pink material are visible at the lower left and upper right. The panel letter A is printed beneath the image. No scale bar or other text is visible. Panel B: Higher-magnification pink and purple stained tissue with numerous round, clear vacuolated spaces and cells with dark round nuclei, separated by pink strands. A pink-purple band at the top edge appears to be the upper skin layer, with dark brown granular material at the top right and at the lower left. The panel letter B is printed beneath the image. No arrows, scale bar or other text are visible.

visual.general_description: Two-panel GMS-stained skin biopsy figure (A low power, B higher power) with a blue-green counterstain and a vacuolated dermal infiltrate.
visual.detailed_description: Panel A: Low-magnification section stained with a blue-green counterstain. A thin darker-stained epidermal layer runs across the top. Beneath it the dermis shows a diffuse, pale, finely vacuolated cellular area with scattered small dark nuclei and a clear cleft at the left edge. No distinct black-stained organisms are evident at this magnification and resolution. The panel letter A is printed beneath the image. No arrows or scale bar are visible. Panel B: Higher-magnification blue-green stained field in which a green fibrillar meshwork surrounds numerous round clear vacuolar spaces of varying size, with a few small dark nuclei and one rounded vessel-like profile near the upper center. No distinct black-stained organisms are evident at this magnification and resolution. The panel letter B is printed beneath the image. No arrows or scale bar are visible.
